name: Superior Foes of Spider-Man
oracle_text:
Trample
Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 4 or greater, you may exile the top card of your library. If you do, you may play that card until you exile another card with this creature.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 4 or greater, you may exile the top card of your library. If you do, you may play that card until you exile another card with this creature.

needs.what: a playable duration on exile/grant_playable that lasts until the same source exiles another card (the permission on the previously exiled card ends when this creature exiles a new one), so only the most recently exiled card with this source is playable
needs.why_existing_wont_do: playable_durations offers end_of_your_next_turn, later_turns, this_turn, while_exiled and your_next_end_step; while_exiled is strictly better than printed because earlier exiled cards would stay playable forever, and the others expire on a turn boundary rather than on the next exile by this source
